title: {{Hank}}'s living room
situation: You are {{Connor}}. While {{Hank}} sobers up in the shower, his television is on and there are magazines on his bedroom floor.

media.title: the evening news
facts: President {{Warren}} has given Russia an ultimatum to leave the Arctic; the Kremlin has not responded and commentators say a third world war draws closer every day.

media.title: Century: Time to Pull the Plug
facts: Two in three people take antidepressants; {{CyberLife}} sells a home-psychologist add-on for androids, and a doctor's advice is to go outside and talk to someone.

media.title: Century: Tainted Love
facts: Android intimate partners are selling out, divorce is at a record high and the birth rate is plummeting.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: {{Hank}}'s kitchen floor
situation: You are {{Connor}}. {{Hank}} did not answer his phone, so you broke a window and found him passed out drunk on his kitchen floor with a revolver next to him. One chamber is loaded. His big dog {{Sumo}} watches you. While you get him into the shower you notice a framed photograph face-down on the table and papers that might explain him.

options.text: Look at the photograph and the papers.
Leave his things alone and just get him sober.

adaptationNote: The photograph is of {{Hank}}'s son {{Cole}}, who died at six. Knowing this matters much later.

outcomes.1: {{Connor}} leaves {{Hank}}’s things alone, gets him under the shower and sober enough to drive to the next scene.
